config: ulimit -v 8000000 (8 GB virtual memory cap) before each Julia invocation
conclusion: Memory pressure IS the mechanism. With fixed ulimit -v 8000000, the batch-shift effect disappears (std drops from 21.13 Myr to 0.74 Myr). All three runs hit the 70 Myr target (vs uncapped runs varying from 12 to 70 Myr).
